unresolved_findings.finding: close_gate_allowed can NEVER return True on a ledger produced by scripts/legacy_observer.py main(). main() only sets ended_at on the PREVIOUS period when a new period is opened; the newest period always has ended_at absent. close_gate_allowed evaluates the last two periods INCLUDING the open one, and 'window not completed' fails the open period. The verdict is therefore permanently close_allowed=false even after two consecutive completed >=24h zero-hit windows have elapsed. Proven empirically with the real module: simulated the exact main() flow with all-zero-hit >=24h windows for runs 1-5 — every verdict False ('need 2 completed observation windows, have 1' then 'missing started_at/ended_at (window not completed)' forever); the same ledger evaluated over the last two COMPLETED periods returns True after run 3. The unit tests (leg10a-f) only exercise the pure function with hand-crafted fully-completed ledgers; NO test covers the main() period-transition flow, so the defect is invisible to the suite. The off-by-one: at run N+1 the two completed windows are N-1 and N, but the gate evaluates [N, N+1].
unresolved_findings.recovery: Evaluate the last two COMPLETED periods (filter periods with ended_at set before taking the tail) — the fix direction I verified returns True after run 3 — OR close the current window (set ended_at) before evaluating the verdict; add at least one test covering the main()-style ledger transition (new period closes previous; two completed zero-hit windows then authorize). Re-review must rerun the FC-705 focused suite and the ledger-transition test.
